operations.title: Operations
operations.intro: Checklists, cash counts and incidents of the stores selected, recorded in the staff app. Choose the stores in the top bar.
operations.readOnly.role: The Operations pages are for owners and managers only.
operations.demo: The demo has no staff app, so it has no checklists, cash counts or incidents. Once a store uses the staff app on Zalo, this page shows them by store, day and shift.
operations.overLimit: Too many rows to show at once; choose fewer stores or a shorter range.
operations.checklist.title: Checklist compliance
operations.checklist.caption: {decided} checklists were due
operations.checklist.sentence: {done} checklists were done on time, {late} late and {missing} missed out of {decided} that were due.
operations.checklist.pending: Today {inProgress} are in progress and {due} are not due yet.
operations.checklist.none: No checklist was due in this range.
operations.checklist.noTemplates: These stores have no checklist yet.
operations.checklist.rule: Due by: the opening checklist before opening time, the mid-shift one before the middle of the opening hours, the closing one within 60 minutes after closing time, from the opening hours in Settings → Stores; for a store without opening hours, done on the day counts as on time. A retired checklist counts only on days someone ran it.
operations.checklist.table: Checklists by store, day and part of the day
operations.runs.title: Each run in detail
operations.runs.hint: Open a run to see each item, reading, who did it and the photos, in the wording of the version it used. Photos load only when opened.
operations.run.gone: This run could not be read.
operations.run.photoFailed: The photo could not be loaded.
operations.run.photoRemoved: The photo was removed after the retention period.
operations.cash.title: Cash counts by shift
operations.cash.caption: {counted}/{closed} closed shifts counted
operations.cash.sentence: {counted} of {closed} closed shifts have a count in the app; {over} are over a threshold and {missing} were not counted.
operations.cash.unmatched: {count} counts are not matched to a shift yet because the shift has not been synced from the POS; the next sync matches them.
operations.cash.reference: Count variance = the count − the expected cash (opening float plus cash payments), judged with the same thresholds as Shifts & cash drawer. The POS drawer is what the cashier entered on the POS at close.
operations.cash.table: Cash counts and the POS drawer by shift
operations.cashState.no_reference: No expected cash from the POS
operations.reopen.title: Reopen for a recount
operations.reopen.hint: Reopen a count so that staff count that shift again; who reopened it and when are recorded.
operations.reopen.confirm: Reopen the count of {shift} on {date} at {store}? Staff will need to count that shift again.
operations.reopen.done: Reopened the count of {shift} on {date}; the shift waits for a recount.
operations.reopen.none: No count to reopen in this range.
operations.reopen.error.forbidden: Only an owner or a manager of this store can reopen a count.
operations.log.title: Incidents, stock-outs and shift handovers
operations.log.caption: {open} not seen yet
operations.log.sentence: {total} entries match the filters: {incidents} incidents, {stockOuts} stock-outs and {handovers} handover notes; {open} not seen, {seen} seen and {resolved} resolved.
operations.log.none: No incident, stock-out or handover note matches the filters.
operations.log.table: Log of incidents, stock-outs and handovers
operations.log.privacy: Written by staff. Do not copy it into messages or elsewhere.
operations.filter.storeHint: Stores are chosen in the top bar.
operations.action.error.forbidden: You cannot confirm this entry: a writer never confirms their own report, and only an owner or a manager of the store can.
operations.photo.removed: The photos were removed after the retention period.
operations.theme.cash.title: Cash counts in the app
operations.theme.missingCounts.title: Closed shifts without a count
operations.theme.missingCounts.sentence: {missing} of {closed} closed shifts have no count in the staff app.
operations.theme.missingCounts.none: Every closed shift in this range has a count.
operations.theme.missingChecklists.title: Missed checklists
operations.theme.missingChecklists.sente: {missing} of {decided} checklists that were due were missed.
operations.theme.missingChecklists.none: No checklist was missed in this range.
operations.theme.demo: This section needs the staff app; the demo has none, so it has no figures yet.
operations.theme.role: This section is for owners and managers only.
operations.theme.window: The last {days} days of the range
operations.theme.windowSentence: Staff app figures cover at most the last {days} days of the range.
